story_text:
## What Do the Experts Think?
## Small in size. Ready for more.
Unlike many lights designed for a single purpose, the WUBEN G6’s compact design opens up more ways to use it. Lightweight and easy to carry, it fits naturally into everyday life and on the go. Wherever life takes you, you can find a place for the G6.
## Powerful illumination
The slim, portable WUBEN G6 offers adjustable brightness from 1 to 500 lumens and a beam distance of up to 66 m. From evening walks and home repairs to outdoor adventures and unexpected power outages, it’s ready to light up everyday moments.
## Side Light for Tasks & Signals
Beyond its main beam, the WUBEN G6 offers practical light right at the front. Two 1 W white LEDs deliver 100 lumens for close-up tasks, from checking your gear to making a quick repair. A compact red/blue indicator adds even more versatility: its 2-lumen red light can be used as a signal, and the indicator also shows the light’s power status.
## Slim. Slimmer. G6.
Slim, easy-to-carry design has been at the heart of the WUBEN G6 from the start. Thinner, then thinner still: at its narrowest point, the G6 is nearly as thin as a USB connector. The result is a thoughtful balance of everyday functionality and effortless portability.
## Clip It On. Grab It Fast.
The WUBEN G6’s concealed, three-way rotating clip quickly became a standout feature for its versatility. For the G6, we’ve taken that idea further with a thicker, sturdier clip and a wider opening, making it easier to attach to your gear and designed for a more secure hold. Clip it on, adjust the angle, and keep your light right where you need it.
## Detachable Mini Knife
On the side opposite the G6’s rotating clip, a compact folding blade is integrated for everyday tasks and outdoor needs. It’s handy for opening packages, cutting cord, or taking care of quick campsite tasks.
The mini knife detaches from the G6, so you can choose how you carry it. Keep it attached for an all-in-one setup, or remove and stow it separately when you want to carry the G6 on its own. We’re also exploring additional accessory-mounting options to give you more ways to customize your setup.
## Light Touch. Responsive Switch
We took a different approach with the G6’s switch. It responds to a light press with clear, direct tactile feedback, making operation simple and intuitive. Water won’t interrupt its response. Even underwater, the switch remains usable. A breakthrough in switch design that makes everyday operation easier.
## Built-In Protection. Use While Charging.
The G6’s high-density 400 mAh battery is protected against overcharging, over-discharge, overcurrent, and short circuits. Electrical insulation adds another layer of protection. The G6 also supports use while charging, so you can keep using the light while it’s plugged in.
## Keychain Ready. Clip On and Go.
Made for everyday carry and long-term use, the WUBEN G6 clips onto clothing, backpacks, or key rings with a light press and detaches just as easily. Tested through more than 100,000 press cycles, the sturdy spring clip can support a 5 kg load, providing a secure, dependable hold day after day.

## Standard vs. Premium: What’s the Difference?
The Standard and Premium versions are identical in every way except for their materials. The Standard version is CNC-machined from 7075 aerospace-grade aluminum, while the Premium version is made from stonewashed titanium alloy.

faq.q: What material is WUBEN G6 made of?
faq.a: The Standard Edition is CNC-machined from 7075 aerospace-grade aluminum alloy. The Platinum Edition is CNC-machined from titanium alloy with a stonewashed finish.

faq.q: What are the main light’s color temperature and CRI?
faq.a: The main light is rated at 5000K with a CRI of 70.

faq.q: What is the red light for?
faq.a: The red light provides convenient close-range illumination and helps improve visibility. Its flashing mode doubles as a signal and a handy battery-status indicator.
Yes. The clip rotates up to 90° so you can adjust the direction of the light.
The G6 is rated IP67 for dust protection and resistance to powerful water jets. It is not designed for underwater use.

faq.q: What is the battery capacity, and how long does it run?
faq.a: The WUBEN G6 has a 400 mAh battery and offers up to 72 hours of runtime in moon mode.

faq.q: What is the blade made of? Is it replaceable?
faq.a: The G6 features a replaceable high-carbon steel blade with a stonewashed finish and a sharpened cutting edge.

faq.q: What is the built-in blade designed for?
faq.a: The concealed utility blade is intended for light everyday cutting tasks, such as opening packaging. It is not designed for prying, twisting, or cutting hard materials.

faq.q: When do you expect to ship?
faq.a: We’re currently in the pilot production stage. Once the pilot run is complete, we’ll carry out testing and make any necessary adjustments. Based on our current schedule, we expect to begin shipping in January 2027. We’ll keep backers updated as production progresses.
We plan to ship rewards via international air parcel. Shipping is currently estimated at US$8–$12 per unit, depending on the destination. We’ll confirm the final cost before fulfillment.
